_source: Apple's App Store localization codes, as fastlane 2.239.0 ships them in fastlane_core/lib/fastlane_core/languages.rb (ALL_LANGUAGES), which mirrors the languages App Store Connect offers. Copied from the apps' sweeps (kcalculate, NutriSpy), 2026-11-25. App Store Connect refuses a localization whose code is not on this list; the codes are Apple's to define, not ours to infer from BCP-47.
